---
title: "Frontend for slim"
execute:
  echo: false
---
```{ojs}

viewof kmax = Inputs.radio([200, 500, 1000], {label: "Carrying capacity", value: 500})

viewof minDem = Inputs.range([1, 20], {label: "Bottleneck Strength", step: 1, value: 4})

viewof Kadjust = Inputs.radio(new Map([["5 years", 0.8], ["20 years", 3.2], ["40 years", 6.4]]), {label: "Kadjust", value: 0.8})

viewof N0 = Inputs.range([1,20], {label: "initial population size (proportion of carrying capacity)", step: 1, value: 2})

viewof numLoci = Inputs.range([100,2000], {label: "Number of loci loci", step: 100, value: 1000})

viewof MU = Inputs.radio(["1e-8", "1e-7", "1e-6"], {value: "1e-7", label: "Mutation rate"})

viewof prek = Inputs.range([1, 256], {label: "Length of complete cycle", value : 14, step: 1})
```

<details>
<summary> **Advanced parameters**</summary>



```{ojs}
viewof nGen = Inputs.number([0, Infinity], {step: 1, label: "Simulation horizon", placeholder: 300, value: 300})

viewof burnin = Inputs.range([1,10], {step: 1, value: 1, label: "burnin generations"})

viewof r = Inputs.range([0,10], {step: 0.01, value: 1.4, label: "r variable for the top-down cycle regulation"})


```

</details>

```{ojs}

md`
minPop = 
${kmax/minDem}

Initial population size:
${kmax/N0}
`

command = `slim -d Kmax ${kmax} -d minDem ${minDem} -d Kadjust ${Kadjust} -d N0 ${N0} -d numLoci ${numLoci} -d MU ${MU} -d prek ${prek} -d ngen ${nGen} -d burnin ${burnin} -d r ${r} ./slimScript.slim`

md`
Command to use:

*${command}*

`
```




```{ojs}


viewof copyButton = {
  const btn = html`<button class="btn btn-outline-primary">📋 Copy Command</button>`;
  
  btn.onclick = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(command)
      .then(() => {
        // Temporary feedback on successful copy
        const originalText = btn.innerHTML;
        btn.innerHTML = "✅ Copied!";
        setTimeout(() => btn.innerHTML = originalText, 1500);
      })
      .catch(err => console.error("Clipboard copy failed:", err));
  };
  
  return btn;
}
  
```



```{ojs}
rawFileURL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JamesLabUofT/frontend-for-slim/refs/heads/main/scripts/phase1_slim_script.slim"
response = await fetch(rawFileURL); 
blob = await response.blob();
viewof downloadSlimScript = {
  const downloadButton = html`<button class="btn btn-outline-primary" download = "slimFile">Download SLiM file</button>`;
  downloadButton.onclick = () => {
    
    try {
      
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP error while fetching slim script! Status : ${response.status}`);
      }
      
      const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = blobUrl;
      a.download = "slimScript.slim";
      a.style.display = 'none';
      
      a.click();
      
      URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl);
      
      
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to download file:', error);
      alert('Could not download the file.')
    }
  }
  return downloadButton;
}

```
